questions.subject: ANTHROPOLOGY
questions.learningObjective: examine human variation using anthropological evidence

stimulus.body: A researcher measures height, skin tone, and blood groups across many populations and finds that most variation occurs within rather than between groups.

questions.stem: Which statement about human variation is best supported by the account?

options.text: Human genetic variation is extensive and mostly distributed within populations rather than in discrete biological races.

options.text: Human variation divides cleanly into a few discrete biological races with sharp boundaries.

questions.subject: ANTHROPOLOGY
questions.learningObjective: examine clines using anthropological evidence
